numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.intro: Write the number in words or in digits. Both cardinal and ordinal numbers come up.

gender.title: Gender & articles
gender.intro: Choose or write the article: definite, indefinite, or contracted with a preposition (do, da, no, na, ao, à).

preposition.intro: Fill the blank with the right preposition: time, place or movement.

possessive.title: Possessives
possessive.intro: See whose thing it is and write the possessive in the right form: meu / minha, teu / tua, dele / dela.

interrogative.title: Question words
